info.name: secrets-api Postman Collection
info.description:
Centralized secure vault for the ForgeSphere platform.
Manages sensitive credentials including Git SSH keys, cloud service account JSONs,
Nexus/Artifactory passwords, and TLS certificates. Provides fine-grained
access control (read-only per service) and automatic secret rotation scheduling.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0
